profiles.title: HDFS · 2,000 official sample logs + block labels
profiles.note: Official block-session labels mapped to sampled records, then any-positive time-window labels. Sparse time-window evaluation is not the paper’s full block-session benchmark.

profiles.title: OpenStack · original 2k normal-only sample
profiles.note: Every sampled line exactly matches the official normal1 collection. No positive examples: recall/F1 are unavailable; use the annotated failure-run preset for two-class evaluation.

profiles.title: OpenStack · 18,434 logs from annotated failure run
profiles.note: Association evaluation: a line is positive iff it contains one of the 4 officially annotated anomalous VM UUIDs; all other lines are negative for this association target. This is NOT independently verified line-level fault ground truth, and can miss faults without a VM identifier. Any-positive labels are aggregated per time window.
